mnemonic.meaning: 礼 has 礻 (altar): you bow at the altar. Thanks, a bow, etiquette.
mnemonic.reading: RAY (れい): you bow and a ray of light falls on you. Same れい as お礼 (thanks).

examples.ja: 先生にお礼を言った。
examples.en: I thanked the teacher.

items.note: お礼 = thanks or a thank-you gift. 失礼 = rude, or "excuse me".

mnemonic.meaning: 稼 has 禾 (grain): you harvest grain to earn your living.
mnemonic.reading: CASA GOO (かせぐ): you earn money to buy a casa, even if it's covered in goo.

examples.ja: アルバイトで学費を稼いでいる。
examples.en: I'm earning my tuition with a part-time job.

items.note: Also 時間を稼ぐ = to buy time, 点を稼ぐ = to score points.

mnemonic.meaning: 鳴 has 口 (mouth) + 鳥 (bird): a bird making a sound. To ring, to sound.
mnemonic.reading: NARA, SUE (ならす): in Nara, Sue rings the temple bell.

examples.ja: 車がクラクションを鳴らした。
examples.en: The car honked its horn.

items.note: Transitive of 鳴る (to ring).

mnemonic.meaning: The world (世) and the space between (間) people in it. Society, people.
mnemonic.reading: SAY, KEN (せけん): "What will the world say, Ken?"

examples.ja: 世間の目を気にしすぎる。
examples.en: He worries too much about what people think.

items.note: The world of people and public opinion, not the planet. 世間話 = small talk.

mnemonic.meaning: The interval (間) of one year (年). For a year, annual.
mnemonic.reading: NEN, CAN (ねんかん): you buy one can a year. Annual tradition.

examples.ja: この町には年間百万人の観光客が来る。
examples.en: A million tourists visit this town every year.

items.note: 年間 = per year or over a period of years: 三年間 = for three years.

mnemonic.meaning: 縁 has 糸 (thread): the red thread of fate tying two people. A connection.
mnemonic.reading: EN (えん): fate connects you, EN-tangled in the same thread.

examples.ja: 彼とは不思議な縁がある。
examples.en: I have a strange connection with him.

items.note: 縁 is also edge or rim (ふち, へり). ご縁 = destiny bringing people together.

mnemonic.meaning: SAP, PARRY (さっぱり): you wash off the tree sap and parry the heat. Refreshed! But ask a question: "not at all," no idea.

examples.ja: シャワーを浴びてさっぱりした。
examples.en: I feel refreshed after the shower.

items.note: With a negative: さっぱり分からない = no idea at all. さっぱりした味 = a light, clean taste.

mnemonic.meaning: 溶 has 氵 (water): something turns into water. To melt, to dissolve.
mnemonic.reading: TOE, KAY, RUE (とける): the ice melts on Kay's toe and she rues it.

examples.ja: 暑さでアイスが溶けた。
examples.en: The ice cream melted in the heat.

items.note: 解ける (also とける) = to come undone or be solved. Different kanji.

mnemonic.meaning: 負 is a person (⺈) over 貝 (money): carrying a load of money you owe. To bear, to carry.
mnemonic.reading: OH (おう)! you grunt as you bear the heavy load on your back.

examples.ja: 彼はその事故で大けがを負った。
examples.en: He was badly injured in the accident.

items.note: Formal: 責任を負う (take responsibility), けがを負う (be injured).

mnemonic.meaning: The proper (正) ceremony (式). Official, formal.
mnemonic.reading: SAY, SHE KEY (せいしき): she hands over the official key at the formal ceremony.

examples.ja: まだ正式に決まっていない。
examples.en: It hasn't been officially decided yet.

items.note: 正式な発表 = an official announcement.

mnemonic.meaning: 好 is like: what you like. Your taste, preference.
mnemonic.reading: CONE, NO ME (このみ): "A cone? No, not me." It's not to my taste.

examples.ja: この色は私の好みではない。
examples.en: This colour isn't to my taste.

items.note: お好みで = as you like. お好み焼き comes from this.

mnemonic.meaning: SOCK, CURRY (そっくり): your sock and the curry are exactly alike. Same color, same smell.

examples.ja: 彼女は母親にそっくりだ。
examples.en: She looks just like her mother.

items.note: 〜にそっくり = the spitting image of. Also "all of it": そっくりそのまま.

mnemonic.meaning: The idea (想) that logic (理) says is perfect. The ideal.
mnemonic.reading: REE-SO (りそう): "REALLY, SO perfect!" That's the ideal.

examples.ja: 理想と現実は違う。
examples.en: Ideals and reality are different.

items.note: 理想的 = ideal (な adjective).

mnemonic.meaning: NON-BEERY (のんびり): a relaxed, carefree afternoon, lounging leisurely with no beer needed.

examples.ja: 休みの日は家でのんびりしたい。
examples.en: On my days off I want to relax at home.

items.note: Slow and easygoing, in a good way.

mnemonic.meaning: Talk (話し) and fit (合う) your ideas together. To discuss, talk over.
mnemonic.reading: HANA, SHE, OW (はなしあう): Hana and she discuss why Hana said ow.

examples.ja: 家族で将来のことを話し合った。
examples.en: We talked about the future as a family.

items.note: 話し合い = a discussion.

mnemonic.meaning: Clap (拍) your hands (手). Applause.
mnemonic.reading: HACK SHOE (はくしゅ): the crowd claps so hard someone hacks off a shoe. Applause!

examples.ja: 演奏が終わると、大きな拍手が起きた。
examples.en: When the performance ended, there was big applause.

items.note: 拍手を送る = to give a round of applause.

mnemonic.meaning: 単 is simple, single: just one simple thing. Mere.
mnemonic.reading: TAN NARU (たんなる): it's a mere tan, nothing serious.

examples.ja: それは単なる噂だ。
examples.en: That's just a rumour.

items.note: Only before a noun. Same idea as ただの.

mnemonic.meaning: The air (気) and taste (味) of something: a feeling, a touch of.
mnemonic.reading: KEY ME (きみ): I have a feeling I lost my key. Same sound as 君 (you).

examples.ja: 風邪気味なので、早く寝ます。
examples.en: I feel a bit of a cold coming on, so I'll go to bed early.

items.note: Mostly as a suffix ぎみ: 疲れ気味 (a bit tired). 気味が悪い = creepy.

mnemonic.meaning: 精 is spirit: giving it all your spirit, at most this much. At best.
mnemonic.reading: SAY, SAY (せいぜい): say it as much as possible, at most twice.

examples.ja: 参加者は精々十人だろう。
examples.en: There will be ten participants at most.

items.note: Usually in kana: せいぜい. Also "do your best" (せいぜい頑張れ, can sound sarcastic).

mnemonic.meaning: 癖 has 疒 (sickness): a quirk you can't get rid of, like a sickness. A habit.
mnemonic.reading: COO, SAY (くせ): saying "coo" after every sentence is his weird habit.

examples.ja: 爪を噛む癖がある。
examples.en: I have a habit of biting my nails.

items.note: Usually bad or odd habits. 口癖 = a pet phrase. 習慣 is a neutral habit.

mnemonic.meaning: Pour (注) your eyes (目) onto it. Attention.
mnemonic.reading: CHEW, MOCK (ちゅうもく): everyone pays attention when you chew loudly. They mock you.

examples.ja: その映画は世界中で注目されている。
examples.en: That film is getting attention around the world.

items.note: 注目を集める = to attract attention.

mnemonic.meaning: Living (生) life (命). Life, existence.
mnemonic.reading: SAY, MAY (せいめい): "Say, May, what's the meaning of life?"

examples.ja: 医者は患者の生命を守る仕事だ。
examples.en: A doctor's job is to protect patients' lives.

items.note: Formal, often scientific: 生命保険 (life insurance). 命 (いのち) is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: Hands (手) that transmit (伝) help. Help, a helper.
mnemonic.reading: TETSU DIE (てつだい): Tetsu helps you carry the iron, but nearly dies.

examples.ja: 引っ越しの手伝いをした。
examples.en: I helped with the move.

items.note: Noun from 手伝う. お手伝いさん = housekeeper.

mnemonic.meaning: Suffering (苦) and pain (痛). Agony, distress.
mnemonic.reading: COOT, SUE (くつう): the coot bird pecks Sue's toe. Agony!

examples.ja: 長い会議は苦痛だ。
examples.en: Long meetings are torture.

items.note: Physical or mental pain. Formal.

mnemonic.meaning: 方 is a person, doubled: persons. People, ladies and gentlemen (polite).
mnemonic.reading: KATA, GATA (かたがた): ladies and gentlemen, please take your seats.

examples.ja: ご来場の方々にお礼を申し上げます。
examples.en: We thank all of you who came today.

items.note: Polite plural of 方. Read ほうぼう, it means "here and there".

mnemonic.meaning: "MOTTA (more) TIE? NIGH (もったいない)!" You throw out a perfectly good tie. What a waste!

examples.ja: まだ食べられるのに捨てるなんて、もったいない。
examples.en: Throwing it out when it's still edible? What a waste.

items.note: A very Japanese feeling about waste. Also "too good for me": 私にはもったいない.

mnemonic.meaning: Turn the plan into reality (実) and go (行). Carrying out, execution.
mnemonic.reading: JIG COAT (じっこう): you put on your jig coat and carry out the plan.

examples.ja: 計画を実行に移した。
examples.en: We put the plan into action.

items.note: Also "run" for a computer program. 実行力 = the ability to get things done.

mnemonic.meaning: PIT, TARRY (ぴったり): the ball drops into the pit and tarries there. A perfect fit.

examples.ja: この靴はサイズがぴったりだ。
examples.en: These shoes are the perfect size.

items.note: Also for timing and suitability: ぴったりの仕事 (a perfect job).

mnemonic.meaning: The essential (要) elements (素). A factor, component.
mnemonic.reading: YO, SO (ようそ): "Yo, so what are the elements?"

examples.ja: 成功には運の要素もある。
examples.en: Luck is also a factor in success.

items.note: Formal. Like "factor" in English.

items.pos: noun, する verb, な adjective

mnemonic.meaning: Peaceful (安) and fixed (定). Stability.
mnemonic.reading: AN-TAY (あんてい): an ant stays steady on the table. Stability.

examples.ja: 安定した仕事を探している。
examples.en: I'm looking for a stable job.

items.note: 不安定 = unstable.
